meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成高端品牌视觉指南与标识系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建品牌指南或标识系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium brand visual guidelines and identity systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create brand guidelines or identity systems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会像品牌设计师一样工作:当你让它做品牌类图像时,它会生成一张完整的品牌工具包图(默认 3×3 网格),包含标志、构造、UI 应用、标语、色彩、字体、实物样机等面板,整体追求极简、克制、有电影氛围,而不是随便画个图标。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成品牌指南板、标志系统、身份手册等品牌视觉类图像时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个咖啡品牌的品牌指南板,极简风格。
say.note: 会得到一张含标志、色彩、字体等面板的概览图。

say.text: 做一张暗黑科技风的 3×3 品牌身份手册图。
say.note: 会按 3×3 网格生成完整品牌系统。

say.text: 为语音助手设计标志系统,并加上色彩和字体。
say.note: 会输出标志及配套应用面板。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude works like a brand designer: brand-image requests yield a single brand-kit image (default 3×3 grid) with logo, construction, UI, tagline, color, type, mockup panels. Minimal, restrained, cinematic — not generic icons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for brand-guideline boards, logo systems, identity decks, or other brand visual images.

say_en.text: Create a minimal brand-guideline board for a coffee brand.
say_en.note: Produces an overview with logo, color, and type panels.

say_en.text: Make a 3×3 brand identity deck in dark-tech style.
say_en.note: Outputs a full brand system in a 3×3 grid.

say_en.text: Design a logo system for a voice assistant, with color and typography.
say_en.note: Gives a logo plus supporting application panels.
